articles.headline: Apple Is Betting Improved Heart and Health Insights Will Boost Watch Sales
articles.summary: Like runners striving to break from the pack, a slew of wearables companies are competing for share of consumers’ health and fitness tracking habits.  With  Apple  latest heart-rate focused updates to its best-selling Apple Watch and an upcoming Health app redesign, it’s hoping to expand an already impressive lead.  Users will be able to calculate their “health age”—a comparison of their overall health measurements with their actual age—as well as a Readiness score that gauges capacity for strenuous activity.

articles.headline: Why Is Everyone Ignoring Snap Stock's High Cash Yield?
articles.summary: Snap (SNAP) stock is 58% below its two-year high. At that price, Snap's free cash flow equals 8.1% of its market value, against 4.5% for the median S&P 500 company. With Snap's debt counted, that cash yield is 6.2%. A yield that high means a business on sale, or one the market expects to shrink. So why are investors paying so little for Snap's cash.
